run_inference_on_datasets: run inference on one or more datasets using a trained DensePose model with a config file
run_inference_with_multi_gpu: run inference using multiple GPUs for faster DensePose testing across datasets
run_inference_with_range: run inference on a specific range of dataset indices for targeted evaluation
run_inference_with_visualization: run inference and visualize detections on dataset images using the vis flag
run_inference_with_custom_opts: run inference with custom config options passed via command line arguments
